proposals.rationale: Pool has zero shallow learners (XGB only depth 9). A depth-4, strongly regularized XGB is bias-dominated, the opposite error structure of the deep/variance-heavy pool, maximizing decorrelation. INT-02 shallow+strong-reg optimum; INT-04: a suboptimal-but-heterogeneous member is an asset.
proposals.expected: Solo R2 0.784-0.786, lowest error-correlation; realistic shot at nonzero blend weight.

proposals.rationale: Every LGB uses feature_fraction ~0.8; halving columns (0.5) + bagging 0.55 forces trees onto different feature subsets - a random-forest-like decorrelation seed bagging cannot provide (INT-07). Add to pool, let weight search judge.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.7860-0.7865; error profile shifted by strong column subsampling.

proposals.rationale: All six CatBoost members sit at depth 9-10, lr 0.03-0.05. Opposite corner: depth 5, lr 0.08, heavy L2, Bayesian bootstrap - most distinct CatBoost error structure. Weight search zeroes it if useless (INT-15), low cost.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.784-0.786; weakest candidate but most distinct.

proposals.rationale: Deep exploration exists for LGB (255 leaves) and CAT (depth 10) but XGB stops at depth 9. Depth-12 depthwise trees with halved columns partition feature space differently from leaf-wise LGB - deep-but-decorrelated member.
proposals.expected: Solo 0.7855-0.7862; moderate decorrelation from depthwise structure.
